CREATING THE REGIONAL AND PROVINCIAL HAOS
Regional HAOS Centers (R-HAOS Centers) and Provincial
HAOS Centers (P-HAOS Centers) shall likewise be created to provide
assistance to developers and intended beneficiaries of housing programs
of the National Government and Local Government Units (LGUs) at the
local level.

socialized and low-cost housing projects.
The Regional Field Units of PMS and the Provincial
Governments
shall be the lead coordinators
of the R-HAOS Centers and P-HAOS
Centers, respectively.
Line departments
and agencies involved in
housing shall provide the manpower support and technical assistance to
these Centers, as necessary.

FUNDING. The Secretary of Budget and Management is
hereby directed to allocate funds from the Organizational
Adjustment
Fund or from any available fund under the annual appropriations
government to support the operations of the Presidential HAOS Centers,
those of the R':'HAOS and P-HAOS Centers.
Subsequent
funding thereon shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.
Funds for the operation of these Centers shall be released through
the PCMH, subject to the submission of the Work and Financial Plan to
the Department of Budget and Management.

REPORTING SYSTEM. The Presidential
HAOS Center
shall submit quarterly reports to the PCMH on its' operations including
those of the R-HAOS and P-HAOS Centers.
